data.title: A notice in the window

memoryNodes.cue: The centre is looking for people to join its team.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 中心正在寻找加入团队的人。

memoryNodes.cue: Some jobs end after the building work; another may continue.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 有的工作在施工结束后终止，另一份可能继续。

memoryNodes.cue: Lin asks whether the job will suit her.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 林询问工作是否适合自己。

data.situation:
On her way home from class, Lin stopped outside the community centre. There was a new notice in the window, beside a photograph of the building before its refurbishment. The centre wanted to recruit people for its front desk. Lin was not unemployed, but she was looking for work that fitted around her course. She took a photograph of the notice and went inside. Front-desk position
We need temporary staff while the main building is being refurbished. A permanent position may become available later. Evening and weekend hours are available. Please send a short application and tell us which days you can work. Lin: Do you offer a chance to learn other parts of the work?
Receptionist: Yes. For example, you can help with events after you learn the desk routine.
Lin: That opportunity sounds appealing. I enjoy helping people find what they need.
Receptionist: Different employers offer different things. Here, working with the community is a big part of job satisfaction.

The centre wanted to recruit people for its front desk. Lin was not unemployed, but she was looking for work that fitted around her course. She took a photograph of the notice and went inside.
readingBlocks.zh: 下课回家的路上，林停在社区中心外。橱窗里有一张新告示，旁边是建筑整修前的照片。中心想招聘前台人员。林并没有失业，不过她在找能配合课程时间的工作。她拍下告示，走了进去。

readingBlocks.en:
Front-desk position
We need temporary staff while the main building is being refurbished. A permanent position may become available later. Evening and weekend hours are available. Please send a short application and tell us which days you can work.
readingBlocks.zh:
前台职位
主楼整修期间，我们需要临时工作人员。以后可能会有长期职位。可安排晚间及周末工作。请发送简短申请，并说明可以工作的日期。
readingBlocks.title: The job notice

readingBlocks.en:
Lin: Do you offer a chance to learn other parts of the work?
Receptionist: Yes. For example, you can help with events after you learn the desk routine.
Lin: That opportunity sounds appealing. I enjoy helping people find what they need.
Receptionist: Different employers offer different things. Here, working with the community is a big part of job satisfaction.
readingBlocks.zh:
林：有机会了解其他工作吗？
接待员：有。例如，熟悉前台流程后可以协助活动。
林：这个机会很吸引我。我喜欢帮人找到需要的东西。
接待员：不同雇主提供的东西不同。在这里，为社区服务是工作满意感的重要来源。
